question: Rohit told Ruchi, “Your mother’s father is the father-in-law of my son”. How is Ruchi related to Rohit?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70b8fc59f55523cbd1c0dcb6157cdd0120d14d1918de4106bf11139640dba2e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c2b33bc034da418d378b784ee917c179f5163d74fded29bbf6ba581e57b38e7.png] 

Clearly, Ruchi is the granddaughter of Rohit.

Hence, ‘**Granddaughter**’ is the correct answer.
